ModMetadata.Author: FlorpyDorp + JXSN
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Stationeers UI Mod[/h1]
Radial inventory and HUD overhaul for Stationeers (procedural Unity UGUI radials + ImGui HUD). Toolbelt, tool, bag radials, SmartStow+, visor HUD, equipment keys. Client-side optional mod. [h3]POC integrated as Unity mod base[/h3]
ModMetadata.InGameDescription:
Stationeers UI Mod WARNING: This is a StationeersLaunchPad Plugin Mod. It requires BepInEx + StationeersLaunchPad.
Stationeers UI Mod — Radials for tools/bags, SmartStow+, two-hand visor HUD. Replaces hotbar friction with modern interaction while keeping physical inventory rules.

Ported from BepInEx proof-of-concept into Unity mod project. Radials are now drawn with a fully procedural Unity UGUI renderer (code-built canvas + runtime mesh wedges).
ModMetadata.ChangeLog: [h3]Version 0.6.1:[/h3] [list] [*] Option B hold mode: resting the cursor on ANY branch wedge (Backpack, a category, a nested bag) now dives into it — hold MMB and hover your way from The Hub all the way to an item, release to grab it [/list] [h3]Version 0.6.0:[/h3] [list] [*] Radial Option B — "The Hub": the toolbelt radial (MMB) grows a top-center wedge that branches into everything Tab opens (search + every worn piece) [*] TAP middle mouse = the toolbelt radial opens sticky; tap MMB again on a wedge to select it (branches navigate, actions run and close), tap empty space to dismiss [*] HOLD middle mouse = transient as always: point at The Hub for a beat (or LMB) to dive in, LMB enters bags/categories, RMB backs out, release runs the hovered action and closes [*] Option B keeps ALL of Option A (STOW wedges, satellites, scroll values, search, parking); pick the schema in F10 or the config [/list] [h3]Version 0.5.0:[/h3] [list] [*] The visor HUD: full-screen UGUI replacement built to the concept art — curved top status bar (UTC, pressure, O2, temp, power, water, suit status), compass ribbon with cardinals + degrees, left equipment column (1-6), bottom hand tray, vitals card with the live 3D player as a cyan hologram, visor-edge vignette [*] Diegetic tiers: full readout only with a powered suit; without one you get felt-sense WORDS (WARM, HUNGRY, THIN AIR) that flare on change; the robot always sees everything [*] Suit power death collapses the HUD in a CRT flicker; a powered suit boots it back panel by panel; low battery causes dropout glitches [*] All THREE curvature implementations: A vertex warp, B RenderTexture dome projection (+scanlines), C curved world-space canvas — switchable live [*] F9 HUD editor: click any HUD element on screen to edit its colours/sizes in a popup right there; hover highlights its palette entries; every colour/font/size/behavior knob with Undo/Redo [*] docs/Moodlets-Reference.md: every vanilla status/moodlet with exact triggers [/list] [h3]Version 0.4.0:[/h3] [list] [*] Generic device settings: every setting vanilla's inventory window shows, with vanilla's live labels (jetpack stabilizer, suit A/C / air / filter / pressure / temperature, helmet visor / light / flush) — SETTINGS wedge everywhere by one shared rule [*] Component satellites: slide over a battery / canister / cartridge for TAKE / REPLACE (full swap list) / its settings [*] Tab parity: all six worn pieces (glasses included) open exactly the radial their 1-6 key opens; empty worn slots are STOW wedges [*] Search is a radial now: SEARCH wedge on top with the text box, results fill the bottom half as draggable wedges, wheel pages [*] Z-grab (mouse-mod key): grab world items under the cursor into the radial drag layer; drag-move the whole radial by its hub; CLOSE button at the hub bottom [*] Shift keeps radials open across actions; E swaps hands (indicator stays lit); bag presentation options (grouping toggle, empty-slot modes, max wedges); icons scale with wedges; chip size + shine intensity in the editor [/list] [h3]Version 0.3.0:[/h3] [list] [*] Option A control schema (F10-switchable vs classic Option D): STOW wedges, device-control child radials with scroll-wheel value adjust, take/open satellites on nested bags, auto-close after actions [*] Search all bags: type-to-filter panel; click puts the item in a free hand or drops it at your feet [*] Drag-out parking: press-drag items out of radials onto the screen, drop them into slots, or RMB-out to drop them all [*] Radial editor (F10): black-screen playground with live example radials; every colour, font, size and thickness tunable [*] Full wedge outlines with side borders, wedge gaps and side-edge anti-aliasing; bold RBNo font; live state under icons (battery %, kPa, stack counts) [*] Custom UIA sorting classes (22 classes for 785 items) replace the game's coarse groups in bag radials [/list] [h3]Version 0.2.0:[/h3] [list] [*] Rebased as StationeersUIMod Unity/SLP mod (namespace StationeersUIMod) [*] Procedural Unity UGUI radial renderer (built in code, no prefabs) as primary [*] Hooked to SLP OnLoaded entrypoint; legacy ImGui painter retained for reference [*] All BepInEx plugin code integrated, patches preserved (fail-soft) [/list]
